review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, self-review of regression design informed by independently reproduced findings
review.decision: Exercise each review blocker through the actual publication, legacy admission, receipt scan and hook entry points.
review.notes: Read independent review 6dab55c89b86095c1b511cbeb0a67fbc for dc978303 on bcd7d82f and inspected the retained five reprobes, writer paths, state post-rename sync contract and Codex Stop resolver. Cases are isolated; no service restart, live test input or actual data crash. Existing CPI-001 through CPI-004 stay intact.

cases.description: A verified cross-pane repair serializes normal incumbent writes and retains newer raw bytes
cases.setup: Real Save and refresh in temporary state. Pause the repair after it archives the old bytes and before final index publication.
cases.action: Attempt non-Codex Save and removal under the lease, then retry once the repair releases it. Separately model an old writer changing the index outside the lease before the final check.
cases.expected: Normal writers cannot report a successful write in the protected window and can publish after the lease. The raw comparison refuses a visible uncoordinated update and preserves the exact newer index.

cases.description: Legacy admission distinguishes missing proof, explicit retirement and cross-home process exit
cases.setup: Managed fixture with missing or intact receipt, an incomplete relocation, explicit End, and independent Codex home scopes. Use controlled process observations.
cases.action: Save a different thread with unknown, live, and positively stopped incumbent evidence, while exercising same-home and cross-home publication and live-reader isolation.
cases.expected: Missing or uncertain evidence and another home's live receipt cannot release the old index. Explicit retirement preserves history but revokes live authority. Exit permits publication after a partial relocation and from another home. Foreign-home receipts never grant live input.

cases.description: A structurally valid other-home receipt competes at its own location only
cases.setup: Private receipts for an independent cross-pane conflict and another Codex home.
cases.action: Add an unrelated other-home receipt, then vary its location to match the repair destination and change private evidence to malformed.
cases.expected: A valid other-home receipt elsewhere does not interfere. A viable competitor at the same location or unreadable record prevents recovery without changing either index.

cases.description: Equal archived bytes after post-rename sync failure are not a persistence receipt
cases.setup: Real private archive creation with controlled failures after visible rename and in the containing resume directory sync.
cases.action: Attempt refresh repeatedly through the visible-but-unconfirmed archive, then allow both durability operations to succeed.
cases.expected: Each failure preserves the incumbent and no receipt upgrade occurs. The retry executes durability work despite visible equal bytes, then recovers the current thread with one exact private archive.

cases.description: Actual detached Codex Stop entry protects both pane markers under wrong or expired binding
cases.setup: Real hook Run, two mocked tmux pane views, private real resume files and initial native/pane state. The payload provides the root session ID and omits the pane and working directory.
cases.action: Invoke with an empty or wrong inherited pane while the primary index is wrong or expired. Repeat with the now-current managed index and independent production freshness checks.
cases.expected: Unassociated Stop stays pane-less, updates only its native thread, and changes neither pane. The recovered owner gets exactly its own completion and event even with a wrong inherited pane. The peer stays active.
